userPromptSubmit.description: Auto-activate relevant skills based on file context and user intent

postToolUse.description: Validate MVVM compliance - BLOCKS critical violations, WARNS on style issues
Detect opportunities to use SerializationUtils or ErrorHandlingMixin
Warn if file exceeds 500 LOC without facade pattern

stop.description: Run flutter analyze before returning control

instructions: Always follow Butlery's MVVM + Repository architecture pattern
Use ServiceLocator.get<T>() for runtime access (never sl<T>())
Extend BaseService for all instance-based services
Extend BaseFirebaseRepository for all Firebase repositories
Validate permissions on all repository CRUD operations
Use AsyncOperationMixin for simple loading/error state management
Files >500 LOC must use facade pattern with extracted modules
Never use FirebaseFirestore.instance directly - inject repository
Use UserService.currentUserProfile for user data (not PermissionService.currentUser)
